name: Centralize the knowledge base structurally in /infra (the local-root organization plan)
description: Andrew-direct 2026-07-08. Audit the ajb_workspace filesystem, specifically /infra, and make sure everything is optimized for recording the true nature of the cloud + resources. Come up with a PLAN to better centralize the knowledge base -- at least on a STRUCTURAL level -- in /infra. Follows from NFRA_TERRAFORM. PROBLEM: knowledge of the true nature of the cloud+resources is SCATTERED with no centralized structural home -- across logs (org/logs, daily, git_logs, sessions), runtime compilation (the graph/.comp-graph/marker-oracle/tool_activity), git (decisions in commits), docs (~313 architecture + briefs + deployment), infra/aws (~30 loose docs), org/ (projects/TOs/critical_paths/modules), and the fabric memory. Tribal knowledge with no structural owner -> slow, lossy, does not scale. END-STATE: /infra is the well-organized STRUCTURAL knowledge base -- a clear taxonomy (one SSOT per knowledge class), homeless tribal knowledge CONSOLIDATED into /infra, rightly-placed knowledge (git/graph/org) REFERENCED-in-place not duplicated, an anti-scatter convention. STRUCTURAL project (the shelves + homes + SSOTs + index), NOT a content-rewrite. PRD docs/architecture/NFRA_LOCALROOT_PRD.md.
phase: Phase 1/2: DECOMPOSED + P2 taxonomy DIRECTION settled 2026-07-08 (base COO, Andrew-direct via CTO 168c5d7b1). Owner base COO (SS9 Q1). P1 fs-audit SEEDED (live /infra already substantially organized -- reconcile+index, not greenfield); P2 taxonomy DIRECTION = HYBRID (by-knowledge-class top-level homes infra/aws=estate + infra/system=content + security/linting/orchestration/testing function-classes; project-docs-homes infra/website/ as a governed sub-pattern; infra/README.md static index + infra/system/06_current_state runtime). Resolves CTO arch-note: website/system/aws-terraform are instances of ONE scheme, not independent precedents. SS9 resolved: Q1 owner=base-COO, Q3 reference-in-place-default/consolidate-homeless-only, Q4 static-index+runtime-current-state, Q2 direction-above-ratified-in-P2. COO~B UNBLOCKED: infra/system/ = top-level STABLE home (compiler in org/modules/graph, output infra/system/06_current_state per CTO Q1); index-register in infra/README.md. P3 execution = AE infra-lane (owned-paths) coordinated w/ COO~B + TERRAFORM-P3 + SYSTEM-P2. CTO arch-gates P2 before execution; CVO certs no-forked-SSOT.
blocking: P2 full taxonomy plan (complete per-class SSOT table + migration map + index design) = COO's next deliverable, CTO-arch-gated before P3. P3 execution coordinates the shared infra/ lane with COO~B (SYSTEM-P2) + TERRAFORM-P3 so the three land ONE coherent /infra. Trilogy: LOCALROOT=structure (this), SYSTEM=content (COO~B, /infra/system), TERRAFORM=estate (base COO, /infra/aws/terraform).
depends_on_note: THE TRILOGY: NFRA_LOCALROOT = the STRUCTURE (how /infra is organized as the centralized knowledge base + the SSOT taxonomy + anti-scatter convention + index -- the librarian); NFRA_SYSTEM = the CONTENT (how the system works, in /infra/system -- the books); NFRA_TERRAFORM = the CLOUD RESOURCES managed + /infra/aws/terraform represents them (the estate). LOCALROOT follows into from TERRAFORM (cloud mapped -> /infra structurally represents it). No re-owning; SYSTEM + TERRAFORM populate components of LOCALROOT's structure.
